entries.name: Description of the Omegaverse worldview
entries.content:
There's basically alpha and omega and beta, and beta is just a normal human being. The human race ratio is in the following order: Beta>Alpha>>Omega.
Among alphas, they are divided into Dominant alphas and Recessive alphas, and among omegas, they are divided into dominant omegas and recessive omegas. 
Anyone can become pregnant regardless of gender. In this worldview, ‘breeding propagation’ is the most important purpose. In other words, the purpose of Alpha and Omega is to produce superior offspring. They are slaves to pheromones,  and use them to reproduce their species.

Between alphas and omega, there is a 'fated mate' who is attracted to each other and can find out who they are. Both alphas and omegas tend to be attracted to each other even without a rut or a hit, so there are cases where the alpha bites the omega unconsciously, imprinting it on them.
